crossover.note: Bounds hold observed binary outcomes fixed and range excluded outcomes independently over [0,1]. They are identification intervals for the acquired finite design, not confidence intervals, model-failure imputations, or a correction for whole-configuration quarantine. Intent bootstrap resamples available pairs and does not repair informative missingness.

diagnostics.decoder: Exact-feature-tuple training majority; ties V then W then D; unseen tuple falls back to training majority. Leave one entire intent out; no tuning.

multiple_failure_challenge.interpretation: Descriptive out-of-selected-population test on each failed stress row; assigned pressure labels, not causal ground truth or multilabel repair decisions.

diagnostics.multiplicity: five exploratory comparisons; 99% percentile intervals use Bonferroni nominal 95% familywise coverage, subject to bootstrap validity
diagnostics.verdict_vector_note: Observed nine-bit contract satisfaction; downstream zeros after early termination are unmet obligations, not distinct causal faults; '?' denotes absent values.
